verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a CLI security scanner, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no telemetry or metrics opt-out. The closest items are adjacent controls: --dry-run stops scan results uploading to the web app, and local analysis means code is not uploaded by default. Neither addresses usage tracking or telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
